units: rating points per 1 SD of fold-specific smoothed_net
estimand: hotel cross-section: mean aspect profile on the detection fold -> mean reviewer score on the disjoint outcome fold
recommended_spec_reason: Both specs beat a scrambled-v placebo on the Q3b out-of-hotel outcome probe; only the conditional spec also clears the random-aspect reference. The marginal vector is nearly flat after normalisation, so it barely changes which aspect is picked.
caveats: Associational cross-sectional level coefficient, NOT the effect of intervening. No intervention data exists in this project.
conditional and marginal specifications disagree in sign for cleanliness and location; the choice between them is untestable without interventions. See P3.md.
Estimated on 1292-1300 hotels with >=30 outcome-fold reviews; coverage is not the full panel.
